title.zh: 授予Alfredo L. Noel在达沃省Compostela市镇电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Alfredo L. Noel a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Compostela, Province of Davao
title.orig: An Act Granting Alfredo L. Noel a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Compostela, Province of Davao
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Alfredo L. Noel để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Compostela, tỉnh Davao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Alfredo L. Noel เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Compostela, จังหวัด Davao
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Alfredo L. Noel untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Compostela, Provinsi Davao
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Alfredo L. Noel untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Compostela, Wilayah Davao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1017_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for there is granted to Alfredo L. Noel, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric sale within the Municipality of Compostela, Province of Davao.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase and secure from the National Power Corporation electric heat and power, the National Power Corporation is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender his franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
